subject: 明代北方府城·市场棚（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated game building sprite for tianshu default, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city architectural kit, original anonymous composite, not a reconstruction of a named monument. Realistic ancient Chinese architecture, same natural material realism and detail density as the attached Song stable reference; reference is style ONLY, change architecture to northern Ming gray brick and gray clay tile, modest timber, restrained hard-gable yingshan roof with straight compact eaves. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw 45 degrees, pitch 30 degrees, NO perspective convergence. East ground axis projects down-right at slope +0.5; north ground axis up-right at slope -0.5; vertical posts stay vertical. Thin almost-flat footprint pad with clearly visible left, front, right corners, not a pedestal. Footprint proportions refer to ground axes, NOT canvas proportions. Main light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT; short soft contact shadow toward lower right. Entire object and base uncut, generous transparent margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no opaque background or painted checkerboard. No people, animals, writing, pseudo-glyphs, signs, numbers, modern objects, palace ornament on common buildings, Qing imperial decoration, fantasy, neighboring buildings, sky, water, scenery, thick diorama plinth, broad shadows, tilt shift, toy plastic, cropping. Asset bld_kit_ming_north_market_stall. One tiny 3 by 2 metre market stall with four plain wooden posts, low beige linen canopy stretched over simple timber frame, a wooden front counter holding two woven baskets of grain and folded cloth, rough gray brick flat paving base. No building behind, no tile-roof house, no shop sign. Ground width-to-depth axes ratio 3:2. Front faces screen lower-left. Keep the ground edges at precisely +0.5/-0.5 slopes.

references.role: 仅材质/细节密度参考；不继承宋屋型

negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
footprint_basis: 【建议值】沿宋大理market_stall同功能3×2；design/22 §3.4未细分此项。
visual_review: 已view_image候选1及2。选候选1：布棚、货篮与折布功能可读，原图无文字人物，底面近3:2优于候选2；存在工具半透明光晕，仅按统一几何修边保留内部alpha。入口前无遮挡。
final_view_image_review: 已逐张view_image规范化成品；主体完整、灰砖木构细节可读、透明边距保留；几何warning与单视图能力限制沿用。
